# AlgoPatterns - DSA Pattern Learning Platform

> Master Data Structures & Algorithms through pattern-based learning for technical interviews.

## About

AlgoPatterns is an educational platform that teaches data structures and algorithms using a pattern-first approach. Instead of memorizing individual problems, learners master reusable patterns that apply across hundreds of coding interview questions.

## What We Offer

- 18 algorithmic patterns (Sliding Window, Two Pointers, Binary Search, Dynamic Programming, Graphs, Trees, etc.)
- 300+ curated practice problems mapped to patterns
- Interactive visualizations for algorithm understanding
- Language-specific guides (Go, with Rust, Java, Python coming soon)
- AI-powered learning assistance
